title: LLM_Workflow
summary: A collection of tutorial-style Jupyter notebooks demonstrating LLM workflows, including a self-hosted Ollama/Gradio chat interface and a separate notebook on synthetic data creation. The Synthetic_Data_Creation.ipynb notebook fits a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer from SDV on a sample sales dataframe, using its Metadata schema and evaluate_quality report to assess the generated data.
evidence: source_code/Synthetic_Data_Creation.ipynb: 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer' fit on salesDf, evaluated with evaluate_quality
